title: SIR: Self-improving Red-teaming for Compute Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) are vision-language models that perceive a screen and act on a real operating system through mouse, keyboard, and terminal, and they are increasingly deployed to automate everyday digital tasks. Because they can be exposed to untrusted content while operating, they are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which an adversary plants instructions in content the agent will read and redirects it toward actions that violate the user's intent. Existing CUA safety benchmarks evaluate fixed injections written by hand, which may underestimate the risk posed by an adaptive adversary. We present SIR, a black box IPI attack that (i) composes stealthy injections from a small library of reusable principles stated in plain language and (ii) wraps composition in an iterative feedback loop that diagnoses the victim's failed trajectories and distills the bypasses into new, named strategies that are reapplied across

translated_title: SIR：面向计算机使用智能体的自我改进红队测试
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）是能够感知屏幕并通过鼠标、键盘和终端在真实操作系统上执行操作的视觉语言模型，它们正越来越多地被部署用于自动化日常数字任务。由于它们在运行过程中可能接触到不可信的内容，因此容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）攻击——攻击者在智能体将要读取的内容中植入指令，并将其引向违背用户意图的操作。现有的CUA安全基准评估的是由人工编写的固定注入，这可能低估了适应性攻击者所带来的风险。我们提出了SIR，一种黑盒IPI攻击方法，它（i）从一个由通俗语言表述的小型可复用原则库中组合出隐蔽的注入，并且（ii）将组合过程包裹在一个迭代反馈循环中，该循环诊断受害者的失败轨迹，并将成功的绕过方法提炼为新的、命名的策略，以便在后续攻击中重新应用。
tldr: 提出SIR框架，通过从可复用原则库组合隐蔽注入，并利用迭代反馈循环从失败攻击轨迹中自我学习并提炼新绕过策略，实现对计算机使用智能体的自适应黑盒间接提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: SIR is a self-improving black-box indirect prompt injection attack that composes stealthy injections from a library of reusable principles and iteratively distills bypass strategies from failed trajectories, revealing risks that fixed hand-written benchmarks underestimate for computer use agents.
